source.title: Calendar anomalies and market volatility in selected cryptocurrencies
source.supporting_source: Periodicity in Cryptocurrency Volatility and Liquidity, Journal of Financial Econometrics 22(1), 2024, DOI 10.1093/jjfinec/nbac034

research_question: Does a broad, point-in-time liquid Binance perpetual basket retain a positive Monday open-to-Tuesday-open return premium after realistic costs, and is Monday stronger than adjacent Sunday and Tuesday placebo days?
hypothesis: Recurring weekly participation, funding, and algorithmic-trading rhythms can create a persistent Monday return premium across liquid crypto perpetuals.
data: Binance USD-M USDT perpetuals, 1h aggregated to complete UTC days.
universe_rule: At each candidate day, include only symbols with 30 complete prior UTC days, then hold the top 30 by lagged trailing-30-day quote volume. No asset is selected using strategy returns.
portfolio: Equal-weight long top-30 liquid eligible contracts; one unit gross exposure.
execution: Enter at the selected UTC day's open and exit at the following UTC day's open. Liquidity ranking uses only prior completed days.
development_gate: Canonical Monday net Sharpe >0.70, positive total return, non-negative 2022 and 2023, max drawdown <35%, and Monday mean net return exceeds both Sunday and Tuesday placebo means.
success_gate: Canonical OOS net Sharpe >1.0; positive total return at 2x costs; 2024 and 2025 non-negative; max drawdown <35%; Monday mean net return exceeds Sunday and Tuesday; excluding BTC/ETH remains positive; excluding strongest contributor remains positive; family and global DSR >=0.95.
kill_criteria: Fail development gate => REJECT without consuming OOS. OOS failure of any success criterion => REJECT.
